title: Raw Send
description: What a device captures when the person sends, or when a Behavior fires, and hands to the kernel's freeze_send (ARCHITECTURE §7.4, §8.2). The kernel adds who sent it, the frontier, the strokes and the changes it claims, and stores it immutably. Mark grouping, Anchors and the transcript's Mark placement are computed later from it, where the Agent is. Times are the device's milliseconds since the Unix epoch, the same clock it passes as now_ms with each stroke, so words and strokes line up. IDs are as the device sees them: its own strokes by their stroke ID, an Agent's Elements as <agent>:<id>.

send.description: A new Send ID the device makes.

trigger.description: What sent it: the floating Send button, a Pencil squeeze or double-tap, releasing the mic button, a Behavior (with element and on), a Region's Send button (with region), watch mode, or an Embed's reflex.notify (with element and payload; a tap that claims nothing).

viewport.description: What the screen showed, in Space coordinates.

strokes.description: Strokes to include besides the person's unsent ones, which are always claimed.

said.description: The whole transcript, or text the person typed.

words.description: The on-device transcript, word by word with timings, so Mark IDs can be placed where the person drew each Mark while speaking.

hints.description: Apple's on-device handwriting recognition: which strokes it read as writing, the text, and its confidence. A hint groups those strokes into one writing Mark unless they clearly form a gesture.

crops.description: What the device rendered around the Marks, stored as assets before the Send refers to them.

embed_anchors.description: Each Embed's answer, from the resolve function it registered, for the strokes drawn on it.

region.description: trigger region: the Region whose Send button was pressed; the Send claims only the strokes and changes inside it. trigger watch: the watched Region the snapshot shows. The Send goes to the Region's owner.

user_still_writing.description: trigger watch: true when the person was still writing when the snapshot was taken.

element.description: trigger behavior: the Element that was interacted with. The kernel runs that Element's Behaviors for on (and event): a send action makes a full Send, a notify makes a tap (nothing is claimed and the person's turn goes on), and set and apply_recipe are run by the Link as the Element's owner.

event.description: on embed_event: the event name the Embed emitted.

values.description: on panel_change: component id → the value entered.

payload.description: From an Embed's reflex.notify(payload) or reflex.emit(name, payload); otherwise the Behavior's own payload is used.
